channel.title: CT News Junkie - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from CT News Junkie (ctnewsjunkie.com)

item.title: With Fewer Than 80 Dairy Farms Left, Connecticut Farmers Push Lawmakers For Price Stabilization
item.description: Fewer than 80 dairy farms remain in Connecticut — a 63% decline over two decades. In the heyday of the industry during the 1950s and '60s, the state had nearly 1,000.

item.title: Survey: CT Families Struggling With Debt, Food Insecurity And Effects Trickle Down To Children
item.description: Children are also feeling the effects - as 26% of survey respondents reported a negative impact on their children, the data revealed.

item.title: State Health Dept. Advises Against Eating Fish From West River After Fuel Spill
item.description: “This advisory is being issued as a precaution following a recent fuel oil spill,” said Public Health Commissioner Manisha Juthani. “Residents should avoid consuming fish from this section of the West River while the odor and taste of the fish are impacted from the spill.”

item.title: Rep. Frank Smith To Retire This Year
item.description: State Rep. Frank Smith, D-Milford, won’t seek reelection this year when his third term is completed, staff announced Friday.

item.title: CT Lawmakers Warn Iran Strikes Without Congressional Approval Could Lead To Ground War
item.description: Connecticut's two senators and a U.S. House member accused President Donald Trump of waging an illegal war without congressional authorization and warned the conflict could escalate into a ground invasion, costing thousands of American lives and trillions of dollars.

item.title: Lawmakers Consider Statewide School Cellphone Ban, Sparking Debate Among Students
item.description: Two bills moving through the legislature would require districts to implement “bell-to-bell” cellphone bans, leaving local school boards to determine how the policies are enforced.

item.title: Incarcerated Suspect Who Escaped From Hospital Apprehended, CT Officials Say
item.description: Officials said the department, Connecticut State Police and New London police coordinated efforts, and the individual was taken into custody without incident.

item.title: CT Could Ban Gas-Powered Leaf Blowers In New Bill
item.description: Senate Bill 319 would make it illegal to sell gas-powered handheld or backpack leaf blowers by Jan. 1, 2029, and would make it illegal to use them by Sept. 1, 2030.

item.title: Lamont, CT Police Chiefs Push For Ban On Sale Of ‘Convertible’ Pistols
item.description: House Bill 5043, An Act Concerning the Manufacture and Sale of Convertible Pistols, would ban the future sale and importation of “convertible” pistols in the state.

item.title: Carney Announces He Won’t Seek Reelection After Six Terms
item.description: State Rep. Devin Carney announced Monday he will not seek reelection this fall after serving six terms representing the 23rd House District that includes Old Saybrook, Lyme, Old Lyme, and part of Westbrook.
